summary: Sturm Ruger & Co Inc (Ruger) filed an 8-K on May 2, 2026, disclosing a cooperation agreement with Beretta Holding S.A., which had previously submitted a notice of intent to nominate directors for Ruger's 2026 Annual Meeting. Under the agreement, Beretta withdrew its nomination notice and ceased solicitation, while Ruger agreed that Beretta may designate up to two board directors subject to CFIUS approval. The sole director nominees at the 2026 meeting remain Ruger's nine originally-recommended candidates. Beretta's right to designate directors extends through the 2029 annual meeting, with Ruger agreeing to nominate and support those candidates at the 2027 and 2028 meetings. The agreement includes a standstill provision. No price, premium, or financial advisors were disclosed. What to watch: CFIUS review timeline and any subsequent activist actions.
